# publicrecords MCP Actors

> Official public-records Actors for agents via Apify MCP.

MCP pin URL: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper,publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper,publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper,publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper,publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper

## Actors
- EU TED Notices: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper — EU public procurement notices from the official TED Search API v3.
- USASpending Awards: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper — US federal contract/IDV awards from the official USASpending.gov API.
- Grants.gov Opportunities: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper — US federal grant opportunities from the official Grants.gov search2 API.
- UK Find a Tender: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper — UK above-threshold Find a Tender notices via official OCDS 1.1 API.
- Legistar Meetings: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper — US city council meetings/agendas/minutes from public Legistar clients.

Disclosure: Published by the publicrecords maintainer on Apify.
